mode: Bounded desk research; no fieldwork, participant review or publishing
existing_basis: Current manuscript and prior dongariya-niyamgiri-20261103.json record identify the same Dandapat and Niyogi evidence family; these are reopened sources, not independent corroboration.

recommendations.suggested_paraphrase: Singari Jakesika's changing fields also changed her meals. In Niyogi's November 2022 account, her household's turn towards horticulture reduced millet cultivation; she increasingly ate subsidised rice instead.
recommendations.editorial_use: Open with this named household consequence, then introduce the book's wider scope. Keep the existing account of her husband's decision; avoid repeating the same change twice.
recommendations.source: Deepanwita Gita Niyogi, The Citizen, 19 November 2022, reproduced by IWMF
recommendations.locator: Opening Singari Jakesika account, paragraphs before and after the first photograph
recommendations.inspection: Relevant original reporting reopened and read
recommendations.limits: A reported Gandili household experience, not a measured regional dietary trend. Publication date does not date the interview. No need to add acreage, income, age or subsidy price.

recommendations.suggested_paraphrase: Dandapat describes neighbours and relatives helping households short of workers or affected by illness. The household receiving help supplied food for the group. Cooperation could therefore answer a family's immediate difficulty as well as the demands of cultivation.
recommendations.editorial_use: Replace the existing generic shared-labour sentence, rather than append a second account. Attribute the descriptive claim to the study; the final sentence is an explicit synthesis of that description.
recommendations.source: Sujatarani Dandapat, Man In India 101(3–4), 2021, pp. 159–173
locators: Printed p.160 / PDF p.2 identifies Kurli focus
Printed p.168 / PDF p.10, Organization of work teams
recommendations.inspection: Relevant PDF text reopened and read; no fresh screenshot inspection
recommendations.date_scope: Preliminary work beginning June 2017; intensive work September 2017–June 2018; later shorter visits mentioned but not dated
recommendations.limits: Study-centred account, not a universal village rule. Paragraph also records occasional small contributions to a village fund; therefore do not describe all arrangements as wholly cash-free. Preserve horticulture/family-labour distinction as the author's account. Do not adopt the paper's evaluative stereotypes, causal certainties or unsupported population-wide claims.

additional_scope_checks.result: Source identifies Palari as Samburu Kadraka's wife and states their title was joint despite her concern about women's authority. Existing chapter's crop-choice wording is accurate; do not simplify it into women having no legal title. Do not assign her a surname not given in the passage.

Confirms Rayagada block/place context and lists both Kui and Kuvi. Population footnote refers to historical 2010 micro-project data, not current population. Retain current separate CIIL language distinction; the museum list does not make the two names synonyms.
additional_scope_checks.editorial_use: Keep as short context after the human opening; no expansion into an administrative profile.
